zoe: FYI scheduling a short rolling window on phoenix-pool for NIC microcode + fan-profile tweak. Window 2026-06-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Cohorts: 2 racks at a time, stagger 18m. Expected capacity dip ~12%.

mike: ACK. Exclude racks with label dedicated=reserved?

zoe: Yes excluded. Canary: px-can-01 then px-can-02. Success gates: 5m error spike <0.5%, p95 shift <60ms, no stateful evictions.

tara: Autoscaler tweak: bump max nodes +3 for window, scale-down delay 25m. I'll push the patch and revert after +1h.

ops-bot: [maintenance created] id=maint-2026-179999, window=2026-06-12T02:00:00Z/2026-06-12T04:00:00Z

mike: Preflight checklist posted: node inventory, prefix-cache hit, storage detach smoke. I'll run kvseed check 30m prior.

finance-bot: cross-region backfill cost flagged. Approve up to $1.5k if needed; tag costs ops:phoenix-0626.

zoe: Router fallback ready: if phoenix p95 >220ms route to eu-west1. Oncall assigned?

oncall-scheduler: oncall assigned: tara for 02:00-06:00.

tara: ACK, I'll monitor dashboards and take pager. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: [maintenance started] maint-2026-179999 started 02:05 UTC. px-can-01 cordoned.

mike: Canary metrics look good after reboot: p95 +14ms, errors flat. Proceeding with batches.

ops-bot: [maintenance complete] maint-2026-179999 closed 04:03 UTC. Summary: rolled 8 racks, transient p95 bumps, no evictions, no cross-region backfill. Postmortem draft to follow.
